title: Stability analysis and long-time convergence of a partial differential equation model of two-phase ageing
summary: Recent biological evidence suggests the presence of a two-phase ageing process in several species. We introduce a system of two age-structured partial differential equations (PDE) representing two phases of ageing of a wild population. The model includes a coupling of both equations through birth and transition between phases and non-linearities due to competition. We show the existence, positivity and uniqueness of weak solutions in a general setting.
